CustomField.formula: "REG-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-" & LEFT(Id, 5) & "-" & MID(TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 1, 2) & MID(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 1, 2) & MID(TEXT(SECOND(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 1, 2)& "-"& TEXT(Serial__c)
CustomField.label: Registration Number
